summary: The 8-K filed by Vistra Corp. on July 14, 2026, reports the results from the PJM Capacity Auction for planning year 2028/2029, not a special situation. Vistra cleared approximately 10,924 MW at a weighted average clearing price of $325.00 per megawatt-day. This is a routine operational disclosure with no transaction, activist campaign, or strategic review. No board recommendation or advisor is named. The filing is purely informational under Item 8.01, with no deal terms or structural mechanics to analyze. No risk-arb angle applies.
